Definition: heavy; figuratively in a good sense (numerous) or in a bad sense (severe, difficult, stupid)
BiblicalUsage: 1) heavy, great; 1a) heavy; 1b) massive, abundant, numerous; 1c) heavy, dull; 1d) hard, difficult, burdensome; 1e) very oppressive, numerous, rich
